# `intercompany-draft` commands

## `intercompany-draft create`

Save an untargeted local proposal for an advance or expense allocation. For example, amount_minor_units 10000 in USD means 100.00. No company, relationship or remote account is selected; nothing posts.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | intercompany.post |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/intercompany-draft.create` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow intercompany-draft create --date 2026-11-01 --amount-minor-units 10000 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Prepare local intercompany work" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "intercompany-draft create", "input": {"date": "2026-11-01", "amount_minor_units": 10000}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | `--date` | string | yes | no | — | Proposed accounting date; saving a draft does not post or reserve a period.; minimum length 10; maximum length 10; pattern "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$" |
| `amount_minor_units` | `--amount-minor-units` | integer | yes | no | — | Positive proposed amount in integer minor units, never a floating-point amount.; greater than 0; maximum 9223372036854775807 |
| `currency` | `--currency` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Home currency; omit to use this company's home currency. |
| `offset_account` | `--offset-account` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Optional eligible local account ID or full name. No counterpart lookup occurs. |
| `memo` | `--memo` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Local user-authored proposal; never fetches or targets another company. |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--dry-run` | Validate and preview without writing. |
| `--reason TEXT` | Short reason for the write. |
| `--source-ref TEXT` | Identifier of the source that triggered the write. |
| `--interactive` | Prompt for input fields not supplied as arguments or options. |
| `--directive TEXT` | Standing-instruction code or id cited by the write. |
| `--idempotency-key TEXT` | Retry-safe key for this create command. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/intercompany-draft.create`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |

## `intercompany-draft update`

Replace a local untargeted draft with its expected version and a reason. Omitted optional fields clear their values. Nothing posts or reserves a remote record.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | intercompany.post |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/intercompany-draft.update` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow intercompany-draft update 01ARZ3NDEKTSV4RRFFQ69G5FAV --expected-version 1 --date 2026-11-02 --amount-minor-units 2500 --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Prepare local intercompany work" --json`

| `E_NO_ACTOR` | This login is not mapped to a Bookflow user. |
| `E_ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND` | No such organization. |
| `E_PARTIAL_WRITE` | The authoritative write committed, but a secondary update remains incomplete. |
| `E_PERMISSION` | The acting user may not run this command here. |
| `E_REASON_REQUIRED` | This write needs a reason: a short phrase naming what triggered it (--reason on the CLI, a top-level reason on MCP, the X-Bookflow-Reason header on HTTP). |
| `E_RECORD_NOT_FOUND` | No such record. |
| `E_SCHEMA_BEHIND` | The database schema is behind this version of Bookflow; run `bookflow upgrade`. |
| `E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` | The database schema revision is not known to this version of Bookflow; upgrade Bookflow. |
| `E_UNAUTHENTICATED` | No valid credential: log in, or send a bearer token. |
| `E_USAGE` | Invalid command syntax. |
| `E_VALIDATION` | Invalid input. |
| `E_VERSION_CONFLICT` | The record changed since the version you read. |
